decisive_items: Figure 1 Title: Squamous cell carcinoma from a mediastinal mass
Contrast CT chest: showed lobar and segmental pulmonary emboli in right middle and lower lobes
response.rationale: The mediastinal mass with P40-positive, TTF-1/napsin A-negative immunohistochemistry is diagnostic of squamous cell carcinoma; pulmonary embolism is a secondary complication, while anemia and CKD are incidental findings.

rejected.why: Pulmonary embolism is a complication of the malignancy, not the primary diagnosis.
Anemia is a nonspecific finding secondary to chronic disease or malignancy.
Chronic kidney disease is indicated by creatinine but is not the most likely unifying diagnosis.
